title: Cat Sat
summary: A rhythmic exploration of stillness and observation. The cat sits, watching the world, with sensory details woven through simple CVC words.

pages.scene: A tabby cat sitting peacefully on a soft cushion, watching with half-closed eyes
The cat's silhouette against a window, completely motionless, patient
A tiny insect scurrying across the floor, bright and quick
Cat's tail twitches slightly, eyes tracking movement
The cat tucked into a small corner, barely visible, eyes glowing
Cat waiting in the afternoon light, sunbeams dancing around it
Golden afternoon light streaming through windows, everything bathed in warmth
Cat basking contentedly in a pool of warm sunlight
